draft.executive_summary: An investigation was conducted on account ACC-0074 belonging to Fiyaz Aggarwal following an AdverseMedia match. The subject matched entry AM-0009 on confirmed sanctions with 100% name similarity and matching date of birth, yielding a confidence score of 0.95. Consequently, the case is recommended for escalation to human lead analyst review and potential regulatory reporting.
draft.investigation_narrative: Vision verification confirmed agreement on Aadhaar and PAN details for holder Fiyaz Aggarwal with zero disagreeing fields. KYC analysis for account ACC-0074 showed declared annual income of ₹24,30,000 as a Software Engineer. Over 90 days, 17 credits totaled ₹4,32,625 (annualized ₹17,54,535) and 22 debits totaled ₹4,31,409 (annualized ₹17,49,604). Behavior showed minor mismatches including 5 cash deposits totaling ₹1,81,218 and 20 transactions in the busiest month. AdverseMedia screening identified a critical match on entry AM-0009 for confirmed sanctions with 100% name match and matching birth date (2001-01-06), yielding 0.95 confidence, alongside match AM-0031 for adverse news. Graph analysis found zero linked accounts across 35 screened counterparties. The TransactionPattern stage was not run, leaving evidence incomplete regarding automated transaction pattern analysis.
draft.compliance_conclusion: Due to a confirmed sanctions match under AM-0009, this account requires immediate escalation in accordance with SANC-002. Compliance action and mandatory reporting procedures must be initiated pursuant to SANC-003. The analyst recommends escalating the file to senior review.
